item.title: Report: Quonset Business Park generates $7B annually for R.I. economy
item.description: NORTH KINGSTOWN – Quonset Business Park generates $7 billion annually in economic activity for Rhode Island, including $2.2 billion in household income, according to a new economic impact report by Bryant University. The park supports nearly 1 in 17 jobs statewide, accounting for 8.4% of Rhode Island’s gross domestic product, according to the independent report authored […]

item.title: SEC filing of week: Beacon Financial Corp. reports $53.4M profit in Q4
item.description: BOSTON – Beacon Financial Corp., the regional bank created in September 2025 through the merger of Berkshire Hills Bancorp Inc. and Brookline Bancorp Inc. – the former parent company of Bank Rhode Island, reported fourth-quarter net income of $53.4 million, according to its filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Jan. 28. item.title: Meyers elected R.I. GOP chairman
item.description: WARWICK – The Republican Party of Rhode Island has elected Allyn E. Meyers as its new chairman. Myers replaces former chairman Joe Powers, who resigned on Jan. 15. In a statement Myers said he was “deeply humbled and honored to have been elected” and is committed to organizational discipline and measurable results. Friday’s press release […]

item.description: Protesters across the U.S. and Rhode Island are calling for “no work, no school, no shopping” as part of a nationwide strike on Friday to oppose the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown in Minneapolis. item.title: Snow still impacting Providence businesses, residents 4 days later
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The frustration of city business owners is mounting higher than the snow piles left behind from the Jan. 25 storm that dumped 18 inches of snow in the capital city. item.title: SBA: Rhode Island small businesses received $179M in loans in 2025
item.description: SMITHFIELD – Rhode Island small businesses received $179 million in loans in fiscal year 2025, a 56.9% increase over the previous year. A total of 387 loans were approved across the SBA’s 7(a), 504 and Microloan programs from Oct. 1, 2024, through Sept. 30, 2025, the U.S. Small Business Administration announced on Thursday. item.description: EAST PROVIDENCE – Emma Pendleton Bradley Hospital has launched a redesigned website that improves accessibility to information and services, hospital officials say. item.title: Rhode Island Medical Imaging to open new facility in Pawtucket
item.description: PAWTUCKET – Rhode Island Medical Imaging Inc. will cut the ribbon on a new facility at 407 East Ave. later this month. The location, which will consolidate services formerly provided across two facilities in Pawtucket and Providence, will offer advanced MRI, CT, ultrasound, X-ray and mammography services under one roof. item.title: Brown University Health opens new Cancer Institute in Foxborough
item.description: FOXBOROUGH – Brown University Health recently expanded its Massachusetts services with the opening of a new Cancer Institute. The center, located at 70 Walnut St., provides specialized medical and radiation oncology services.
